spec.title: SoC estimé (%)
spec.description: Dernier SoC BMW + énergie Acrel L2 depuis x 0,83 / capacité (tools/soc_estime.flux). Indépendant de la plage de temps.

spec.query:
import "array"
import "date"

bmw_last = (p) =>
  from(bucket: "buckbuck")
    |> range(start: -7d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bmw" and r.property =~ p)
    |> last()
    |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

soc = bmw_last(p: /stateOfCharge\.displayed/)
cap = bmw_last(p: /batteryManagement\.maxEnergy/)

compteur_a = (stop) =>
  from(bucket: "buckbuck")
    |> range(start: -30d, stop: stop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "acrel" and r.topic == "passerelle-energie-waveshare/sensor/acrel_energie_import__e_l2__ev_/state")
    |> last()
    |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

e0 = compteur_a(stop: date.add(d: 1s, to: soc._time))
e1 = compteur_a(stop: now())
gain = (e1._value - e0._value) * 0.83 / cap._value * 100.0

array.from(rows: [{_time: now(), _value: if soc._value + gain > 100.0 then 100.0 else soc._value + gain}])

spec.title: Charge à 85 % : heure
spec.description: Estimation : énergie restante (SoC estimé -> 85 %, rendement 0,83, capacité BMW) / puissance L2 à plein régime (max sur 60 min des moyennes de 10 min). Calé sur 5 charges jusqu'à 100 % (oct. 2026), précision ~±10 min. Vide si la voiture ne charge pas.

spec.query:
import "array"
import "date"

bmw_last = (p) =>
  from(bucket: "buckbuck")
    |> range(start: -7d)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bmw" and r.property =~ p)
    |> last()
    |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

soc = bmw_last(p: /stateOfCharge\.displayed/)
cap = bmw_last(p: /batteryManagement\.maxEnergy/)

compteur_a = (stop) =>
  from(bucket: "buckbuck")
    |> range(start: -30d, stop: stop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "acrel" and r.topic == "passerelle-energie-waveshare/sensor/acrel_energie_import__e_l2__ev_/state")
    |> last()
    |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

e0 = compteur_a(stop: date.add(d: 1s, to: soc._time))
e1 = compteur_a(stop: now())
gain = (e1._value - e0._value) * 0.83 / cap._value * 100.0
l2 = (every) =>
  from(bucket: "buckbuck")
    |> range(start: -60m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "acrel" and r.topic == "passerelle-energie-waveshare/sensor/acrel_puissance_active_l2/state")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: every, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

recent = from(bucket: "buckbuck")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "acrel" and r.topic == "passerelle-energie-waveshare/sensor/acrel_puissance_active_l2/state")
  |> max()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
charging = if length(arr: recent) > 0 then recent[0] > 1.0 else false
p_full = (l2(every: 10m) |> max() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value

est = if soc._value + gain > 100.0 then 100.0 else soc._value + gain
need_kwh = (85.0 - est) / 100.0 * cap._value / 0.83
minutes = if need_kwh <= 0.0 then 0.0 else need_kwh / p_full * 60.0 + 0.0
now_ms = float(v: int(v: now())) / 1000000.0

array.from(rows: [{_time: now(), _value: (if minutes == 0.0 then 0.0 else now_ms + minutes * 60000.0)}])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => charging)

spec.title: BMW - Batterie EV : SoC affiché et estimé (%)
spec.description: SoC affiché BMW (événementiel : début et fin de trajet, parfois pendant la charge) et SoC estimé par l'énergie Acrel L2 x 0,83 / capacité depuis le dernier SoC (recalé à chaque SoC reçu, plafonné à 100 %). Rendement 0,83 : 0,82 mesuré sur la charge complète 59 -> 100 % du 24/10, 0,86 sur les charges partielles.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "buckbuck")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bmw" and r.property == "vehicle.powertrain.electric.battery.stateOfCharge.displayed")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with topic: "SoC BMW (affiché)" }))
  |> group(columns: ["topic"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, column: "_value", fn: last, createEmpty: false)

import "date"
import "internal/debug"

debut = date.sub(d: 3d, from: v.timeRangeStart)

soc = from(bucket: "buckbuck")
  |> range(start: debut, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bmw" and r.property == "vehicle.powertrain.electric.battery.stateOfCharge.displayed")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

cnt = from(bucket: "buckbuck")
  |> range(start: debut, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "acrel" and r.topic == "passerelle-energie-waveshare/sensor/acrel_energie_import__e_l2__ev_/state")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

join(tables: {s: soc, c: cnt}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      soc: r._value_s,
      c: r._value_c,
      e0: if exists r._value_s then r._value_c else debug.null(type: "float")
    }))
  |> fill(column: "soc", usePrevious: true)
  |> fill(column: "e0", usePrevious: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.soc and exists r.e0 and exists r.c and r._time >= v.timeRangeStart)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      topic: "SoC estimé (Acrel)",
      _value: if r.soc + (r.c - r.e0) * 0.83 / 38.1 * 100.0 > 100.0 then 100.0 else r.soc + (r.c - r.e0) * 0.83 / 38.1 * 100.0
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["topic"])

spec.title: Consommation réelle EV (kWh / 100km)
spec.description: Énergie livrée à la voiture (Acrel L2) divisée par la distance parcourue (odomètre BMW) sur la période. Inclut les pertes de charge (rendement ~0,83) : c'est la consommation au compteur, pas celle du véhicule. Choisir une période couvrant des cycles complets de charge/roulage.

spec.query:
distance = from(bucket: "buckbuck")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "bmw" and r.property == "vehicle.vehicle.travelledDistance")
  |> spread()
  |> set(key: "metric", value: "distance_km")

energy = from(bucket: "buckbuck")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "acrel" and r.topic == "passerelle-energie-waveshare/sensor/acrel_energie_import__e_l2__ev_/state")
  |> spread()
  |> set(key: "metric", value: "energy_kwh")

union(tables: [distance, energy])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_start"], columnKey: ["metric"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._stop,
      _value: if exists r.distance_km and r.distance_km > 0.0 then r.energy_kwh / r.distance_km * 100.0 else 0.0
    }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
